phase.goal: Give the deterministic simulation its authoritative integer map grid, lane definitions, cell/world conversions, passability, neighbor ordering, and a little-endian .mapdesc codec without changing the renderer or the .mba v1 container
in_scope: MapGrid SoA storage in a caller-owned arena
MapCell flags, movement cost, integer height band
Q16.16 cell/world conversions with bounds status
Deterministic neighbor ordering and passability queries
Canonical hash inclusion with one recorded SIM_LOGIC_HASH bump
out_of_scope: .mba v1 changes or typed map payloads
Renderer, game, or presentation changes including the derived heightfield mesh
Flow fields, A*, avoidance, or unit movement
Command, event, or replay format changes
dependencies: Merged main at or after 4f66af17e9b8ad65c9b5238426775f656d2811fe (M4.1 accepted)
phase.done_condition: Exact-head CI is green with new map tests in every configuration, the codec rejects every malformed fixture at the first invalid boundary, two identical map loads plus 10,000 ticks hash identically in Debug and Release, the controlled mutation still reports tick 4321 position_x entity 7, and the slate records the single logic-hash bump

tasks.goal: Record the untouched post-M4.1 build matrix, oracle, and logic hash before any map edit
tasks.context: Every later slice must be able to show it did not change authoritative behavior until S5
tasks.output_contract: The slate names the exact baseline commit and observed Debug, RelWithDebInfo, Release oracle and logic hashes
tasks.done_check: All three warning-as-error configurations pass every CTest entry and the controlled mutation reports tick 4321 position_x entity 7

failure_states.trigger: Any untouched configuration oracle or boundary check fails
expected_evidence: Failing command and first diagnostic are recorded

verification_handoff.method: Re-run the matrix from clean main
expected_evidence: Every configuration reports all tests passed
Oracle hashes match the recorded values

tasks.goal: Implement MapGrid SoA storage, map_init validation, and Q16.16 cell/world conversions
tasks.context: The map is the substrate every later gameplay slice reads; its representation and rounding must be fixed first
tasks.output_contract: map.h exposes MapGrid, map_init, map_cell_index, map_cell_to_world, map_world_to_cell returning status codes per ADR-0009 with no float and no STL

output_artifacts.description: engine/sim map storage and conversions with tests

tasks.done_check: map_tests round-trip every boundary cell, reject out-of-range world coordinates and overflowing dimensions without mutation, and pass in Debug and Release

failure_states.trigger: A float, STL container, exception, or RNG draw appears in map sources
expected_evidence: Isolation lint or compiler policy check names the file

verification_handoff.method: Independent run of map_tests plus check_sim_boundary and compiler policy checks

tasks.goal: Implement passability, movement cost, and the fixed N E S W NE SE SW NW neighbor order with the diagonal corner rule
tasks.context: Neighbor order is part of determinism; it must be a contract before any pathing exists
tasks.output_contract: map_is_walkable, map_cost, map_neighbors with bounded output and stable ordering

output_artifacts.description: Passability and neighbor queries with golden tests

tasks.done_check: A golden 8x8 map exercising every flag combination yields bit-identical neighbor lists in Debug and Release

failure_states.trigger: Neighbor order differs between configurations or from the documented order

verification_handoff.method: Independent golden comparison in Debug and Release

tasks.goal: Store LaneDef entries and validate waypoints and spawn cells against the grid
tasks.context: Creep waves and objectives later read lanes; invalid lanes must fail closed at load
tasks.output_contract: map_add_lane rejects off-grid, blocked, or too-short waypoint lists without mutation; spawn lookup by flag

output_artifacts.description: Lane and spawn storage with rejection tests

tasks.done_check: Valid lane accepted; off-grid, blocked, and zero-waypoint lanes rejected with state hash unchanged

failure_states.trigger: LaneDef field order or types drift from section 3.2

verification_handoff.method: Independent run of lane rejection tests
expected_evidence: All rejection cases leave the hash unchanged

tasks.goal: Encode and decode .mapdesc through eng::serialize in the documented field order with fail-closed rejection
tasks.context: Maps must be authorable offline and loadable by AssetId before any content lane exists
tasks.output_contract: map_encode and map_decode with magic MAPD and schema_version 1; rejects bad magic, version, count overflow, truncation, and trailing bytes at the first invalid boundary

output_artifacts.description: Codec, golden file, and malformed-input matrix

tasks.done_check: Golden lane_test.mapdesc round-trips byte-identically and every malformed fixture rejects at the documented boundary

failure_states.trigger: Two encodes of the same grid differ

verification_handoff.method: Independent round-trip and malformed matrix run

tasks.goal: Include the map in the canonical state hash with exactly one recorded SIM_LOGIC_HASH bump and prove replay parity
tasks.context: This is the only slice allowed to move the oracle; it must be isolated and recorded
tasks.output_contract: Map storage hashed in ascending cell order; old and new SIM_LOGIC_HASH recorded in the slate; identical loads plus 10,000 ticks hash identically in Debug and Release

output_artifacts.description: Recorded hash bump and parity proof

tasks.done_check: Debug and Release report the same new final and stream hashes and the controlled mutation reports tick 4321 position_x entity 7

failure_states.trigger: Debug and Release disagree or the mutation report changes

verification_handoff.method: Independent oracle and mutation run in Debug and Release

tasks.goal: Run the full acceptance matrix and close the milestone paper
tasks.context: The milestone is done only when every gate is green and the docs say so
tasks.output_contract: Slate complete, ROADMAP M5.0 status flipped, JOURNAL session prepended, PR opened against main
tasks.done_check: Debug, RelWithDebInfo, Release, debug-asan, and clang-cl UBSan all green; isolation lint green; PR checks green on the exact head

verification_handoff.method: Independent reviewer traces every slate claim to a command or GitHub check
